note: BH-9072. The wake gate mode of a lane that has a catalog/lane-wakes.d file and no MODE_<LANE> knob of its own: off, shadow or on. Settings row lib.lane-wake-gate.mode_default; as a row it also wins over every lane's registry default, so one row stops every gated lane. Read by lwg_mode, never from the env (a stray MODE_DEFAULT export must not move a lane).
